aboutScreen.title: About
aboutScreen.froshiarOverview: Froshiar is a powerful, offline-first point of sale (POS), inventory management, and business accounting system designed specifically for local shops, markets, and growing retail enterprises. Operating with high speed on local SQLite storage, Froshiar ensures complete privacy and zero internet downtime dependency while keeping all your business operations seamlessly synchronized.
aboutScreen.featurePos: Fast POS checkout & receipts supporting Cash, Debt, and FIB digital payments
aboutScreen.featureInventory: Comprehensive inventory, barcode scanning & item serial number tracking
aboutScreen.featureDebts: Customer & supplier ledger with installment settlement records
aboutScreen.featureCapital: Real-time cash drawer tracking, operational expenses & net profit margins
aboutScreen.featureReports: Daily & monthly financial audit statements exportable directly to PDF
aboutScreen.featureStore: Online web storefront integration to showcase your products digitally
aboutScreen.bexDreDesc1: BexDre is a full-service software and digital solutions company. We design, build, and scale the technology businesses run on — from custom business systems, software architecture, and UI/UX design to complete digital transformation solutions that help organizations manage, automate, and grow.
aboutScreen.bexDreDesc2: Our work spans ERP, POS, inventory, and accounting systems. It also includes web, mobile, and desktop applications, e-commerce platforms, cloud solutions, and API development. Every system we build is engineered for reliability, scalability, and long-term performance.
aboutScreen.bexDreDesc3: Behind every project stands a dedicated UI/UX team, a dedicated social media agency team, a dedicated branding team, a professional design team, and a software engineering team — combining strong technical foundations with thoughtful design to deliver products that are powerful and easy to use.
aboutScreen.bexDreDesc4: Froshiar is one of our flagship products — a complete offline-first business management system built for local markets. It reflects what BexDre stands for: practical, professional technology that helps every business manage, automate, grow, and digitally transform, without complexity or unnecessary cost.

capital.title: Capital & Cash Drawer
capital.subtitle: Manage initial capital and cash-bounded purchases
capital.introTitle: Please read this overview before activating:
capital.point1Desc: By activating this feature, you deposit a designated starting cash fund into your drawer for store operations and purchasing.
capital.point2Desc: When active, cash purchases cannot exceed your available cash drawer balance. For instance, if you deposit 1,000,000 IQD and have zero sales, you cannot make cash purchases above 1,000,000 IQD.
capital.point3Desc: Cash sales immediately replenish your drawer, while cash purchases and expenses deduct from it, giving you total transparent control over your cash.
capital.point4Desc: You can deactivate this feature at any time. When deactivated, all capital records will be erased and the app will return to standard unrestricted purchasing.
capital.agreeCheckbox: I have thoroughly read and understand all the explanations above
capital.modalDesc: Enter the initial cash fund to deposit into the cash drawer:
capital.overdraftNoticeDesc: This amount exceeds available drawer balance and will count against you (negative balance).
capital.overdraftAlertMessage:
The cash drawer balance is insufficient for this withdrawal. If you proceed, the drawer balance will drop below zero and count against you.

Are you sure you want to proceed with this withdrawal?
capital.deactivateMessage: Are you sure you want to deactivate? All your capital data will be deleted completely. The app will return to normal operation with no cash limits on purchases.
capital.insufficientBody:
The required cash for this purchase ({{needed}} IQD) exceeds your available cash drawer balance ({{available}} IQD).

Because the Capital system is active, cash purchases cannot exceed available funds.
capital.drawerStatusTitle: Cash Drawer Status for this Purchase
capital.insufficientBanner: Insufficient drawer balance - You cannot complete this purchase
capital.cannotPurchaseDueToBalance: Cannot complete purchase! Insufficient cash in drawer.
capital.unifiedCashDisclaimer: Cash on hand (sales & expenses) is unified with deposited capital into the till balance.
